headline: Wardwizard Healthcare appoints Diksha Sharma
summary: Wardwizard Healthcare appoints Diksha Sharma as Additional Independent Director for 5 years. She is an advocate and IICA empanelled professional.

headline: Oswal Agro fixes Nov 7 record date for interim dividend
summary: Oswal Agro Mills Ltd has fixed November 7, 2026, as the record date for its interim dividend for FY27. The board meeting to declare the dividend is scheduled for November 4, 2026.

headline: Karnataka Bank appoints Sughosh Nagendra as CTO
summary: Karnataka Bank has appointed Sughosh Nagendra as Chief Technology Officer with effect from October 30, 2026. He brings over 27 years of IT experience.
